purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 13-record item effect batch 020; together these files contain exactly 13 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/spear-of-retribution-617.name: Spear of Retribution [Relic]
items/spear-of-retribution-617.effectSummary: For a chaotic-evil, chaotic-neutral, or neutral-evil wielder, the weapon functions as a +1 returning spear. With the relic connection to Gruumsh, it grants +2 morale on attacks and damage against a foe that damaged the wielder in the previous round, and against a foe that critically hit the wielder in the previous round it also gains keen.

items/staff-unyielding-oak-630.name: Staff of the Unyielding Oak [Relic]
items/staff-unyielding-oak-630.effectSummary: For a neutral, neutral-good, neutral-evil, lawful-neutral, or chaotic-neutral wielder, the weapon functions as a +1/+1 quarterstaff. With the relic connection to Obad-Hai, it can become its bound treant any number of times per day for up to 12 total hours; if reduced to 0 hit points or fewer as a treant, it returns to staff form and cannot transform again for 28 days.

items/sword-of-mighty-thews-623.name: Sword of Mighty Thews [Relic]
items/sword-of-mighty-thews-623.effectSummary: For a chaotic-good, neutral-good, or chaotic-neutral wielder, the weapon functions as a +1 dragon-bane greatsword. With the relic connection to Kord, the wielder is immune to dragon frightful presence while wielding it and gains +5 luck on Reflex saves against dragon breath weapons.

items/sword-virtue-beyond-reproach-619.name: Sword of Virtue Beyond Reproach [Relic]
items/sword-virtue-beyond-reproach-619.effectSummary: For a lawful-good, neutral-good, or lawful-neutral wielder, the weapon functions as a +1 holy longsword. With the relic connection to Heironeous, if the wielder fails a save against an enemy charm or compulsion, that effect is suppressed for 1d4 rounds; afterward the original effect resumes rather than being negated.

items/tabard-of-the-disembodied-629.name: Tabard of the Disembodied [Relic]
items/tabard-of-the-disembodied-629.effectSummary: For a neutral-evil, lawful-evil, chaotic-evil, or neutral wearer, the tabard can make the wearer ethereal for 1 round once per day. With the relic connection to Nerull, it instead can transport the wearer to the Ethereal Plane for up to 10 total rounds per day, split as desired; while there, the wearer's spells affect the Material Plane normally.

items/unholy-surge-4.name: Unholy surge
items/unholy-surge-4.effectSummary: The weapon continuously has the unholy property. On a successful melee hit, it can be activated to deal an extra 3d6 damage to a good-aligned target; activating against a nongood creature wastes that use. It can be used per day a number of times equal to 1 + the wielder's Charisma bonus, and after one creature activates the property no other creature can activate it until the following day.
